name: print-social-new-year-new-you-post-with-orange-angled-panels
title: 'New Year New You' fashion post with orange translucent angled panels and dark fade
whatItIs: A square post with a low-angle photo of a curly-haired woman in an orange hoodie against a mural, translucent orange angled panels, a dark fade at the bottom holding a bold white 'NEW YEAR NEW YOU' headline, two text columns and a white 'Shop now' button with an orange edge.
whatItMeans: Fresh and confident; orange panels pick up the hoodie and push energy across the frame.
techniques: Pick the accent from the outfit.
Layer angled translucent panels over the photo.
Fade to dark at the bottom for text.

vocabulary.definition: A photo shot from below the subject.
